医药拜访角色扮演模拟旨在为医药销售代表、医学联络官及市场培训团队提供系统化的拜访实战演练，通过模拟真实医生反应帮助用户掌握合规学术推广技巧。

核心能力：

多角色医生模拟：四类医生（医学专家/主任医师/主治医师/住院医师）× 七种态度模式 × 强度动态追踪

态度行为引擎：基于 attitude_tracker.py 计算每轮态度变化，实时反馈合规风险与临床判断

六维度评分体系：开场破冰、需求探寻、产品陈述、异议处理、缔结行动、专业精神

合规红线预警：自动识别竞品贬损、过度承诺等违规动作并触发警告

危机修复场景：支持真实对话中的失误-修复循环训练

应用场景：

新代表入职培训：标准化学术拜访流程演练

KOL专项训练：专家级医生的高难度拜访应对

合规红线警示教育：识别并规避违规话术

异议处理技能提升：成本、竞品、疗效等常见顾虑的应对

培训效果评估：六维度量化评分追踪进步

skills.description: Generates complete programmed-cell-death (PCD) / regulated-cell-death (RCD) bulk-transcriptome oncology research designs from a user-provided disease and mechanism theme. Always use this skill whenever a user wants to design, plan, or structure a cancer bioinformatics study built around cell-death patterns, tumor microenvironment, prognostic modeling, immune landscape analysis, mutation profiling, and computational drug sensitivity. Covers five study patterns (mechanism-gene-set, subtype-discovery, prognostic-signature, immune-response stratification, translational drug-hypothesis) and always outputs four workload configs (Lite / Standard / Advanced / Publication+) with recommended primary plan, step-by-step workflow, figure plan, validation strategy, minimal executable version, publication upgrade path, and a strictly verified reference literature retrieval layer with real references only.
